sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL OR o.order_delivered_customer_date < o.order_purchase_timestamp) AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28') AS value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL OR o.order_delivered_customer_date < o.order_purchase_timestamp) AND NOT (o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-05-28')) AS baseline FROM orders.orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= DATE '2018-04-30' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
